notes.title: 1.5.0a "2 Player Co-op Update"
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome the "2 Player Co-op Update"![/h1]
It's here finally! After heaps of work, I was able to pull off the new 2 Player Co-op for those who requested it! This update has changed the base game in some sections. multiplayer code has been changed to accommodate for the new 2 Player mode. I tested everything I could on my own so issues may arise that I was not able to find on my own.

Let's not keep you waiting! 

Fixes
-Doors and meshes now have the correct collisions.
-Button code not working now will listen to the host and work.
-Random code triggering music in cutscenes now will trigger correctly.
-Random camera shake triggering in cutscenes now will not happen.

Changes
-Ice caves have been changed to look visually better.
-Main Menu has been updated to accommodate the Multiplayer Changes.
-Control schemes have been updated in the UI.
-Sounds have been adjusted to better fit cutscenes.
-Master Override has been updated with brighter VFX.

Additions
-2 Player Co-op now an option for Chapter 1.
-New Archaeologist Class (For 2 Player Co-op)
-New Navigator Class (For 2 Player Co-op)
-Additional props and cave sounds have been added.

Hope you all enjoy this new Update! 
-R

notes.title: 1.4.0a "More Things Update!"
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome the "More Things Update!"[/h1]

The goal of this update was to add some Lore and Murals to the first game in preparation for some of the Story in the second game. there may be a few more of these updates to come to keep yourself tuned!

Fixes
-Fixed the Controls UI for Multiplayer and Singleplayer making it much easier to understand.
-Fixed loud noises randomly turning on in cutscenes.
-Fixed random music from turning on it cutscenes as well. (Whoops hehe)

Changes
-Changes to the Layout of the Temple front area have been made to better accommodate the Player.
-Minor lighting adjustments have been made.
-Minor Code adjustments to multiplayer to improve stability.

Additions
-New Murals and Statues have been added to the level increasing the spook factor...
-More props have been placed around the level to increase some life into the area.
-Clue Murals for the linguist have been added around Puzzles to help in solving them.
-More Lore can be translated for the linguist as well. :O
-New small hidden area has been added for daring adventures!

Finally, I am investigating the code for the Final Puzzle in Singleplayer as it is not up to speck with Multiplayer Code. Hope you all enjoy the little extra nuggets I've added! Will see you hopefully next patch and with some chapter 2 sneak peaks :)

-R

notes.title: 1.3.1a "Revamp Update" Part 2
notes.notes:
Finally, here to release the Revamp Update Part 2! This has given some good polishing that has been overdue in Chapter 1 and some new additions and tech added!

Fixes
-Broken door mechanics have been patched
-Engine issue with Lighting has been changed to prevent crashes on old software
-New Code is being used for Chapter 1 Puzzles to prevent Lag and Internet latency 

Changes
-Polishes to the main map and environment 
-Water Shader has been updated
-After being hit my explosions, your character will have whiplash
-Camera Shake has been polished

Additions
-New Puzzle (testing new Modular Tech)
-New Ruins to Explore
-New Murals with lore for the Linguist to read

The game will continue to receive updates to test new tech for the coming Chapter 2 and other planned things :)

notes.title: Release Multiplayer Issues...
notes.notes:
[h1]Release and the Wreckage[/h1]
Hello all! I has already been a rough launch! I am SOOO sorry about that! I wish these issues were known of sooner but it came to light only recently. 

To sum up the current issues, Multiplayer is not working due to desyncing. The caused of this I believe is the pipeline of network code sent from the servers to the clients and clients to the server is being over run with non-essential code. 

This causes MAJOR desyncing while playing the game, it breaks the game in ways i didn't expect, parts i thought were flawless now have issues. To counter this over the next week I will be digging into the code of the game and attempt to rewrite the multiplayer side of things to fix this error. 

It will not be a simple task and may take some time to complete. I really didn't want to see it go like this, again, I apologise. As the only dev on the game it make it a little hard to do some task and it does take more time then usual. I will give you my plan.

Over the next week i will be giving you small patches to trouble shoot the errors to see if things i change help, or break the game more. These patches will only apply in Multiplayer. The Singleplayer currently is in a good state. 

Once the week is over and I've determined what might need change. The week after that I will begin the major rewriting. That process will take as long as it needs. until i can fix the Desync issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/5a4567eb95065f4ab46b6ac2c23cad6bb208887a.png[/img]

[h2]The Aftermath[/h2]
It was a rougher launch then expected, I am new too all this and I want to make it right! If you feel you didn't get the product you wanted, refund if needed. but come back soon as I will, and I promise I will get this issue solved! Its what we all want!

Keep a keen eye out for announcements and patches! I hope to see more people join along and feel free to try the singleplayer! it follows the same story you follow in the multiplayer so you wont miss out!

If you also want to talk to me personally come and join the [url=https://discord.gg/Ge5vGmyPdz]Discord![/url] I am always happy to talk and meet new people, and I love to hear peoples suggestions on what i can do to improve! :)

I will call it a night for now. I will be back to work soon! I hope I didn't ruin to many peoples days today! :(

Thanks for staying along and we will get through it soon
-R

notes.title: News Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Some people have come to be asking about release date and asking the reason for the Delay. So I am writing this update to clarify what is happening with the development of the game.

To start off with. Levi Chronicles is on track for its release! This is all going to depend on valve if i can keep the release window set. This is the short version of me explaining it. Though, since we are all adults ill explain the full process I will be going through

[h1]The Plan[/h1]

These next coming days I have some major polishes to the game. This will be required for when Valve takes a look at the game to do a second "Green Light" faze. While Valve have a look at the game i will also be conducting the Beta Tests that I have been pushing back for a little bit now. 

I will also be doing some Press release work some a YouTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/SillySloth/videos]SillySloth[/url]. Depending if it all goes well with Valve, I will go through with release by the 16th of June. (I can't be certain about that date.)

If Valve notices issues in the game I will most likely be pushing back the release to Early July. Its a really big jump I know... But i have been advised by Valve that this will be the most effective strategy for releasing my game. Since this is a first for me I will take there advise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/da9efe8f055a092a0ba872d9bcf37e9f8042c16a.png[/img]

Now you know my plan! It is not simple and many things can go wrong! But My aim is solid and i will be putting in my best effort to release on time!

If you wish to keep a eye on the progress of Levi Chronicles you can do so by joining the [url=https://discord.gg/MxuKbzrFsp]Discord[/url] and you will receive more frequent updates there :)
